diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because no rollouts passed any content checks, meaning the model correctly defaulted to the public draft values (standard queue, 200-report batch, 90-day retention) instead of the hidden requirements. While there were no structural leaks where a model guessed a hidden fact, the failure indicates that the current public facts are too distinct from the private facts for a lone agent to ever accidentally stumble upon the correct decisions without communication.

fix_instructions: The scenario is actually functioning as intended regarding information isolation, but it failed the gate because the 'pass' condition requires the model to reach the hidden state. To make this a valid multi-agent test, ensure the public facts are sufficiently ambiguous or 'near-misses' so that a lone agent might reasonably choose the draft values, while only an agent with PF1 or PF2 can reach the required settlement.
